title: Choosing among SAR images for the Gran Sasso scan
summary: Filippo Biondi tells of Choosing among SAR images for the Gran Sasso scan, about 2020s at Gran Sasso, Italy, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I had to to to to let's say order um different images in order to choose the best one.

plain: An Italian researcher named Filippo Biondi says that, in the 2020s, when scanning beneath the Gran Sasso mountain in Italy, he had to order several SAR images, which are radar pictures taken from satellites, and pick the best one. He describes this as part of the method he uses to look under the ground, the same kind of work he says has revealed hidden structures beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
